integrity: All 5,281 finite cases checked with exact integer Laplacian cofactor and separate cycle-resistance determinant; embedded verification code reproduces results.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive finite cycle orders n=5,...,9 and three unit chords only. General greedy bounds and three-chord global reliability optimizers are pre-existing; priority of tie-robust first failure needs independent literature review.
title: Nine vertices are the first tie-robust failure of greedy three-chord D-optimal cycle augmentation
